Package com.example.ecolums

Class AdminDashboard

java.lang.Object
com.example.ecolums.AdminDashboard
public class AdminDashboard extends Object
Service/controller class that encapsulates all privileged admin operations.

Provides methods for managing users (reset password, export data, delete data), publishing and deleting sustainability tips, creating campus goals, updating calculation metrics, and triggering goal-progress recalculations. Every write operation also appends an immutable AuditLogEntry to Firestore.

Collaborators: ProgressTracker, Leaderboard, AuditLogEntry.

Outstanding issues: triggerGoalRecalculation is a stub — the full recalculation logic in ProgressTracker is not yet wired up.

    • triggerGoalRecalculation

      public void triggerGoalRecalculation(CampusGoal goal, AdminDashboard.OnCompleteCallback callback)
      Manually triggers a recalculation of a campus goal's current progress.

      Called after a CalculationMetric update so that the displayed progress reflects the revised CO₂ factors (AC 4 of the calculation metrics user story).

    • publishSustainabilityTip

      public void publishSustainabilityTip(String title, String summary, String bodyContent, String category, List<String> imageUrls, String videoUrl, List<String> externalLinks, AdminDashboard.OnCompleteCallback callback)
      Publishes a new sustainability tip or educational article.

      Satisfies AC 1 (Authorized Access — only admins can create content), AC 2 (Multimedia Support — imageUrls and videoUrl fields are stored), and AC 3 (Categorization — SustainabilityTip.CATEGORY_TRANSPORT etc.).

      After saving, sends a broadcast notification to all users informing them of new content (AC 5).

      Parameters:
      title - Headline of the tip.
      summary - Short snippet for the list view.
      bodyContent - Full body text (Markdown supported).
      category - One of the SustainabilityTip CATEGORY_* constants.
      imageUrls - Firebase Storage URLs of attached images (may be empty).
      videoUrl - Optional video URL (may be null).
      externalLinks - Optional list of further-reading URLs (may be null/empty).
      callback - Invoked with true on success.

    • updateCalculationMetric

      public void updateCalculationMetric(String metricKey, double newValue, double previousValue, AdminDashboard.OnCompleteCallback callback)
      Updates a single CO₂ conversion factor and records the change in the audit log.

      Satisfies AC 1 (Centralized Formula — admin edits a specific factor), AC 2 (Multiple Metric Update — any metricKey can be changed), and AC 3 (Audit Log — who changed what and when).

      After a successful write, calls triggerGlobalMetricRecalculation() to satisfy AC 4 (Automated Recalculation of campus-goal progress).

      Parameters:
      metricKey - The key of the metric to update (e.g. CalculationMetric.KEY_BIKE_PER_KM).
      newValue - The new conversion factor value.
      previousValue - The old value (for the audit log).
      callback - Invoked with true on success.

    • updateGlobalPrivacyDefault

      public void updateGlobalPrivacyDefault(boolean shareByDefault, AdminDashboard.OnCompleteCallback callback)
      Updates the default privacy setting for new users — whether their data is shared with campus clubs by default (opt-in vs opt-out).

      Satisfies AC 3 (Global Privacy Defaults). The setting is stored in a platformConfig Firestore document and applied when new users are created.

    • deleteUserData

      public void deleteUserData(String targetUserId, AdminDashboard.OnCompleteCallback callback)
      Permanently deletes all personal sustainability data logged by a user ("Right to be Forgotten" request).

      Satisfies AC 4 (Data Deletion). Deletes the activityLogs sub-collection and resets point-related fields on the user document. The Firebase Auth account is NOT deleted here — that requires a separate admin SDK call (Cloud Function).

      Parameters:
      targetUserId - UID of the user whose data should be erased.
      callback - Invoked with true on success.

    • exportUserData

      public void exportUserData(String targetUserId, AdminDashboard.OnReportExportedCallback callback)
      Exports all personal data for a user as a JSON string (data portability).

      Satisfies AC 4 (Data Export Requests). Collects the user's profile and all their activity log entries and serialises them.

      Parameters:
      targetUserId - UID of the user whose data to export.
      callback - Receives the JSON export string, or null on failure.

    • createChallenge

      public void createChallenge(String title, String description, String goalType, double targetValue, String targetUnit, com.google.firebase.Timestamp startDate, com.google.firebase.Timestamp endDate, String rewardBadgeId, int[] notificationMilestones, AdminDashboard.OnCompleteCallback callback)
      Creates a new green challenge or competition and persists it to Firestore.

      Satisfies AC 1 (Challenge Creation Portal). The challenge is initially set to Challenge.STATUS_UPCOMING and transitions to Challenge.STATUS_ACTIVE on its start date (handled by a Cloud Function).

      Parameters:
      title - Display title (e.g. "Plastic-Free February").
      description - Short description for the public gallery.
      goalType - One of the Challenge GOAL_TYPE_* constants.
      targetValue - Numeric target participants must reach.
      targetUnit - Human-readable unit (e.g. "km", "kWh").
      startDate - When the challenge begins.
      endDate - When the challenge ends.
      rewardBadgeId - Badge to award on completion (may be null).
      notificationMilestones - Percentage thresholds for in-app nudges.
      callback - Invoked with true on success.

    • getChallenges

      public void getChallenges(String statusFilter, AdminDashboard.OnChallengesLoadedCallback callback)
      Fetches all challenges from Firestore, ordered by start date descending.

      Can be filtered by Challenge.STATUS_ACTIVE, Challenge.STATUS_UPCOMING, or Challenge.STATUS_COMPLETED; pass null to load all statuses.

      Parameters:
      statusFilter - One of the Challenge STATUS_* constants, or null for all.
      callback - Receives the list of challenges.
